research_notes: Blocked after official roster, direct interview, contemporaneous hospital bio, trustee accounts and targeted hours searches: missing dates/hours at early brokerage, individual FTE in banking/policy work and leave boundaries.

ASFA interview describes six years maternity leave without exact endpoints and compresses subsequent employment chronology. Do not count an uninterrupted twenty-year career or back-calculate leave dates from children, titles or elections.

AustralianSuper's 2016 trustee accounting classification differs from nonprofit legal structures at some other funds. Retained as privately controlled financial-services employment candidate, subject to precise employing entity and FTE verification.
Non-executive directorships are excluded even where government controls the organisation. Neither unknown headline becomes zero.

Follow-up2026-10-03: Fed Square's 2014–15 directors' report resolves the governance interval as 26 September 2014–15 June 2015 and confirms meeting attendance. This supersedes the earlier unresolved conflict between the prospective September2014 welcome and the parliamentary biography's year-only2015 label; governance remains excluded from employment headlines.

Searches of historical governance reports and public financial-services profiles did not resolve banking/policy FTE or six-year leave boundaries. Financial Standard profile was subscription-only; no bypass attempted. APH retirement-inquiry footnotes open returned Internal Error; indexed hearing reference remains a lead only.

Next leads: individual employer appointment/FTE records for banking and AustralianSuper, original brokerage name, and six-year maternity-leave endpoints. Totals remain unknown; excluded governance is not employment.
